source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free root beer float in a stable three-quarter view with one thick handled glass mug, one clear handle, one dark root-beer fill, exactly one large vanilla scoop, one irregular foam cap, exactly one striped straw, exactly three small bubbles inside the drink, two open-paper glass highlights, thick imperfect black outlines, and one broken cool-gray shadow. The rejected v1 sheet remains private because panels 2-3 added dark graphite fill that disappeared at the inking stage. The approved v2 simplifies an ambiguous second scoop into the persistent foam cap so every count stays readable.

process_strategy: Reserve the mug, handle, drink line, one scoop, foam cap, straw, three bubbles, two highlights, and shadow in pale construction; wrap those same footprints with handmade contours; stop the drink and foam around the reserved scoop and the mug wall behind the handle; add earthy retro marker color before limiting the final panel to outline, fill, highlight, and edge cleanup.

final_elements.description: One mug envelope and inner rim with a reserved side handle, root-beer level, one large scoop circle, foam lobes, one straw route, three bubble circles, two glass highlights, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: handled glass mug rim base and root-beer fill contours
final_elements.description: One sturdy three-quarter glass mug with a thick rim, tapered sides, heavy base, one clear handle, and a dark drink plane around the reserved ice cream.

final_elements.description: Exactly one large vanilla scoop, one irregular foam cap with varied lobes, one diagonal striped straw, exactly three small bubbles inside the drink, and two open-paper glass highlights.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline foam hatching and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces every established mug, handle, scoop, foam, straw, bubble, highlight, and shadow contour with sparse foam and glass hatching.

final_elements.name: root-beer brown vanilla cream muted-aqua red and cool-gray marker fills
final_elements.description: Earthy root-beer brown in the mug, vanilla cream in the scoop and foam, muted aqua and red on the straw, and cool gray in the glass edges and shadow with visible marker streaks.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free root beer float, one three-quarter view, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep one mug, one handle, one scoop, one foam cap, one straw, three bubbles, two highlights, and one shadow after those routes appear.
The drink and foam must stop around the reserved scoop, the straw may pass behind only that scoop, the far mug wall must stop behind the handle, and the shadow may not cross the glass.
Do not add a face, cherry, spoon, second drink, text, logo, brand mark, table scene, enclosing outline, sticker edge, badge frame, arrows, labels, numbers, signature, or watermark.
The final panel may not introduce a mug edge, handle, scoop, foam lobe, straw stripe, bubble, highlight, hatch cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean drink art, polished AI poster rendering, or glossy icon art.
